title: Worklist keeps filters, shows cards on a phone, drops deleted assets
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions. Raising a work order also needs create and edit work orders.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. Your organization has two workplaces (locations), e.g. "Calgary South" and "Red Deer", and your user can open both; you switch between them with the location control in the header.
  4. A disposable test asset with a worklist row (tag its name ZZAUTOTEST), which you will delete, and a disposable test customer with an enrolled asset, which you will delete.
custom_steps:
1. Activate the Overdue tile, the Compliance inspection chip and the location filter "Calgary South", type a search and sort by Customer; open Work Orders, then come back. Read the address bar.
  2. Reload the page; then open the same address in a new browser tab.
  3. Narrow the browser below tablet width (or open the tab on a phone); read the layout, scroll the tiles and open a row menu.
  4. Delete the test asset, and delete the test customer, the way the app deletes them today; reopen the worklist.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Coming back keeps the tile, chip, location filter, search and sort; the filters are carried in the address.
  • After reload the filters are restored (saved to your user); the sort is yours; the search is kept only for the browser's Back.
  • Below tablet width each row is a card, the tiles scroll sideways, and the row menu opens as an action sheet.
  • The deleted asset's rows and the deleted customer's rows have left the worklist.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10570 (S13, The maintenance reminders worklist), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S13 (S13-R39, S13-R42, S13-E5); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
